name: Bank Account
description: A bank or credit-card account with its imported transaction feed, categorised and matched to invoices and expenses.

global.schema:
type BankAccountState {
  name: String
  institution: String
  iban: String
  kind: AccountKind!
  currency: String!
  openingBalance: Float!
  transactions: [Transaction!]!
  lastImportedAt: DateTime
}

type Transaction {
  id: OID!
  bookedAt: DateTime!
  amount: Float!
  counterparty: String!
  description: String
  reference: String
  category: TransactionCategory!
  contactId: String
  matchedDocumentId: String
  matchedKind: MatchKind
  status: TransactionStatus!
  importBatch: String
}

enum AccountKind {
  CURRENT
  SAVINGS
  CREDIT_CARD
}

enum MatchKind {
  INVOICE
  EXPENSE
}

enum TransactionStatus {
  "Reported by the bank, not booked yet: shown, not counted, not reviewed; the booked entry replaces it"
  PENDING
  NEW
  CATEGORIZED
  MATCHED
  EXCLUDED
}

enum TransactionCategory {
  UNCATEGORIZED
  SALES
  SUPPLIES
  PAYROLL
  RENT
  SOFTWARE
  TRAVEL
  MARKETING
  TAX
  BANK_FEES
  TRANSFER
  OTHER
}

operations.name: SET_ACCOUNT_DETAILS
operations.schema:
input SetAccountDetailsInput {
  name: String
  institution: String
  iban: String
  kind: AccountKind
  currency: String
  openingBalance: Float
}

errors.name: CurrencyLockedError
errors.description: The account already holds transactions in another currency

operations.name: IMPORT_TRANSACTIONS
operations.schema:
input ImportTransactionsInput {
  batchId: String!
  importedAt: DateTime!
  transactions: [ImportedTransactionInput!]!
}

input ImportedTransactionInput {
  id: OID!
  bookedAt: DateTime!
  amount: Float!
  counterparty: String!
  description: String
  reference: String
  "True: the bank has not booked it yet (status PENDING)"
  pending: Boolean
}

errors.name: EmptyImportError
errors.description: The import batch holds no transactions

errors.name: DuplicateTransactionError
errors.description: A transaction with the same bank reference exists

errors.name: TransactionPendingError

operations.name: REMOVE_PENDING_TRANSACTIONS
operations.description: Drops pending transactions the bank no longer reports: booked since (the booked entry arrives on its own) or cancelled. Ids already gone are skipped.

errors.name: NotPendingError
errors.description: Only a pending transaction can be removed
